explanation_method: Use scripts/explain_treeshap.py (TreeSHAP via Booster.predict(pred_contrib=True)), NOT the feature_importances_ x |value| proxy in the current production ps_model.py — that method is REJECTED, see 10_explanation_audit.md (33.9% direction agreement with true TreeSHAP, worse than chance).

known_open_items: Counterparty-history feature (exp08) is INCONCLUSIVE (+0.024 nAP, p=0.199, sub-MDE) and is NOT included in this feature set. Revisit if a richer counterparty feature or more folds resolve it.

Model choice within the tied tier {RandomForest, HistGradientBoosting, LightGBM} is not statistically forced — LightGBM chosen here for its exact, dependency-free TreeSHAP path, not for superior ranking quality.
